title: Patient Payment Plan Late Fee Rate by Late Fees Already Booked
content:
**Fee schedule note — rate of the missed-installment late fee on a Patient Payment Plan**

The rate of the late fee for a missed installment is chosen from the late fees already booked on the plan:

- where the count has reached the tier's limit of late fees per plan, the rate is nothing (0.00);
- where no late fee is counted and the tier's limit of late fees per plan is above zero, the rate is 7.50;
- otherwise the rate is the tier's late fee.

The conditions are read in that order: a count that has reached the limit gives nothing even when the count is zero.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Limit of late fees per plan | Tier's late fee (USD) | Rate with no late fee counted | Rate with 1 or 2 counted | Rate with 3 or more counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10.00 | 7.50 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10.00 | 7.50 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10.00 | 7.50 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10.00 | 7.50 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 10.00 | 7.50 | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 (a count of 0 has reached the limit of 0) | — | — |

## Boundary readings

- A count of 2 on a tier with a limit of 3 is below the limit and above zero: the rate is the tier's late fee, 10.00.
- A count of 3 on the same tier has reached the limit: the rate is 0.00.
- A count of 0 on a tier with a limit of 3: the rate is 7.50.
